limits: Only fixed 0/50/100 percent research levels; persistent preferences and Settings audio control are not implemented.
Mute verifies requested silence and explicitly does not establish emitted tones in that capture.
Windows render-session/process-loopback PCM; acoustic speaker/headphone and physical hardware/DAC output unverified.
Windows 11 build 26220 tested. Research capture API requires build 20348+ and does not support ordinary Windows 10 build 19045.
Endpoint mute/volume and active default render session are initial snapshots; process capture is independent of physical endpoint and is not a microphone measurement.
No latency, full-stream quality, AV synchronization, device switching, saves, physical controller or commercial gameplay claim.
Unchanged 2048-frame guest fixture; prior 256-frame concurrent limitation and engine/source/relink/runtime/resource release holds remain.
